catalog.summary: Analysis-Ready, Cloud Optimized (ARCO) ERA5 is a reanalysis data source curated by Google. This data is stored in Zarr format and contains 31 surface variables, pressure level variables defined on 37 pressure levels, and model level variables defined on the 137 native ERA5 vertical levels, all on a 0.25 degree lat lon grid. Temporal resolution is 1 hour.
catalog.title: ARCO_ERA5

catalog.signature: CAMulatorForcing(mode: Literal['cyclic', 'transient'] = 'cyclic', forcing_file: str | None = None, leap_day: Literal['nearest', 'raise'] = 'nearest', cache: bool = True, verbose: bool = True)
catalog.summary: CAMulator prescribed forcing data source: TOA insolation (`mtdwswrf`), sea-surface temperature (`sst`), sea-ice fraction (`sic`) and CO2 volume mixing ratio (`global_mean_co2`, ppm) on the 1 degree CAMulator grid, as shipped with the CAMulator model on HuggingFace. Two records are available: a cyclic climatological year (default; every year of a rollout sees the same forcing) and the transient 1980-2014 record. Files are downloaded on demand and cached.
catalog.title: CAMulatorForcing
